The nearby Star Pupil Protoss fleet urgently gathered on this planet and waited. The border not far away had also increased its defense, guarding against the dynasty's fleet outside the border.

After waiting for two days, they finally received a report of Sisko's arrival at the border.

"Your Excellencies, Leader Sisko has arrived at the border and will be here soon."

Jed heaved a sigh of relief and forced himself to speak.

His expression was slightly dispirited. For the past two days, Han Xiao and Heber had been staying in the room. He suggested that everyone should stay in the room, but Han Xiao and Heber did not even bother with him and did not allow him to leave. Jed could only accompany them in the room for two days. He was sitting on pins and needles, not daring to sleep. His high-strung nerves increased his mental exhaustion, and his complexion did not look good.

To a Beyond Grade A, a mere two days did not require any rest. High-level life forms had a different sense of time and could react in microseconds. They could also adjust the activity level of their cells. The elites that the two of them brought along and the Star Pupil Holy Race guards around them were all Calamity Grade Supers, so they were not affected much. Only the government emissaries like Jed were a little tired.

If they stayed in the room, the pressure that had gathered at this time would dissipate. Therefore, the two of them sat there for two days, increasing the pressure on the Star Pupil Protoss present.

After waiting for a while, there was a commotion outside the door. In their perception, a huge energy source was slowly approaching.

Heber suddenly opened his eyes and nodded slowly. "He's here."

The next moment, the door opened, and Sisko slowly walked in. Everyone's eyes focused on him.

The guards present all heaved a sigh of relief, straightening their backs a little as if they had found their backbone.

"Yo, isn't this Little Xixi? The hero has arrived." Han Xiao changed his posture and joked.

Sisko glanced at him and walked to the seat opposite the two of them. Jed, who was originally sitting there, hurriedly got up and made way for Sisko to sit down.

"Didn't you want to see me? I'm back. What do you want? Just say it."

Sisko's tone was solemn.

However, the next second, Han Xiao suddenly raised his hand, and a mechanical structure covered his arm. Mechanical Force flashed, and the machinery continued to expand, turning into a huge palm that pushed forward.

The table and sofa in front of him were all pushed away, and the mechanical palm hit Sisko directly, smashing him into the wall.

The whole room shook."What are you doing?"The situation was so sudden that the guards' expressions changed drastically. They immediately wanted to help their leader.However, at this time, Hella and the rest of the Black Star Guards released their auras toward the surrounding guards. The oppressive aura was filled with warning intent, and the Bloodshed Land Vanguard Officials were also glaring at them.The atmosphere suddenly became tense. At this moment, Sisko's serious voice came from below the mechanical palm."Don't do anything."The mechanical palm was compressed bit by bit and left the wall. At this time, Sisko was completely embedded in the alloy wall, looking a little pathetic. He used his psychic power to pull himself out of the twisted metal wall and stared at Han Xiao, not intending to fight back."You almost killed me. Do you have a problem with me hitting you?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes."No."Sisko took a deep breath. He knew that this was a show of strength to destroy his prestige, so he had to endure it.
